107:     if (!std::filesystem::is_directory(directory, error) || error) {
108:         return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::FileOpenFailed, error.value()));
109:     }
110: 
111:     std::vector<std::filesystem::path> book_paths;

114:         if (error) {
115:             return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::FileOpenFailed, error.value()));
116:         }

120:             book_paths.push_back(entry.path());

231: std::vector<Index> SearchEngine::search_and(std::string_view query) const {
232:     std::vector<std::string> words;
233:     std::unordered_set<std::string> seen_words;
234: 
235:     for (std::string& word : tokenize(query)) {
236:         if (seen_words.insert(word).second) {
237:             words.emplace_back(std::move(word));
238:         }
239:     }
240: 
241:     if (words.empty()) {
242:         return {};
243:     }
244: 
245:     std::unordered_map<size_t, size_t> book_match_counts;
246: 
247:     for (const std::string& word : words) {
248:         const auto found = inverted_index.find(word);
249:         if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
250:             return {};
251:         }
252: 
253:         std::unordered_set<size_t> matched_books;
254:         for (const Index& index : found->second) {
255:             matched_books.emplace(index.book_id);
256:         }
257: 
258:         for (size_t book_id : matched_books) {
259:             book_match_counts[book_id]++;
260:         }
261:     }
262: 
263:     std::unordered_set<size_t> matched_books;
264:     for (const auto& [book_id, count] : book_match_counts) {
265:         if (count == words.size()) {
266:             matched_books.insert(book_id);
267:         }
268:     }
269: 
270:     if (matched_books.empty()) {
271:         return {};
272:     }
273: 
274:     std::vector<Index> matches;
275:     for (const std::string& word : words) {
276:         const auto& indices = inverted_index.at(word);
277: 
278:         for (const Index& index : indices) {
279:             if (matched_books.contains(index.book_id)) {
280:                 matches.push_back(index);

282:         }
283:     }

290: std::vector<Index> SearchEngine::search_phrase(std::string_view query) const {
291:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
292:     if (words.empty()) {
293:         return {};
294:     }
295: 
296:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(words.front());
297:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end()) {
298:         return {};
299:     }
300: 
301:     std::vector<Index> matches;
302:     for (const Index& start : first_word->second) {
303:         std::vector<Index> phrase_match{start};
304:         bool is_phrase = true;
305: 
306:         for (size_t offset = 1; offset < words.size(); ++offset) {
307:             const auto found = inverted_index.find(words[offset]);
308:             if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
309:                 return {};
310:             }
311: 
312:             const auto next = std::ranges::find_if(found->second, [&](const Index& index) {
313:                 return index.book_id == start.book_id && index.line == start.line &&
314:                        index.word_idx == start.word_idx + offset;
315:             });
316: 
317:             if (next == found->second.end()) {
318:                 is_phrase = false;
319:                 break;
320:             }
321: 
322:             phrase_match.push_back(*next);
323:         }
324: 
325:         if (is_phrase) {
326:             matches.insert(matches.end(), phrase_match.begin(), phrase_match.end());
327:         }
328:     }
329: 
330:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
331:     return matches;
332: }

408: std::vector<Index> SearchEngine::search_near(std::string_view query, size_t dis) const {
409:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
410:     if (words.empty()) {
411:         return {};
412:     }
413: 
414:     if (words.size() == 1) {
415:         return search_or(query);
416:     }
417: 
418:     const std::string& word1 = words[0];
419:     const std::string& word2 = words[1];
420: 
421:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(word1);
422:     const auto second_word = inverted_index.find(word2);
423:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end() || second_word == inverted_index.end()) {
424:         return {};
425:     }
426: 
427:     std::vector<Index> matches;
428: 
429:     for (const Index& first : first_word->second) {
430:         for (const Index& second : second_word->second) {
431:             if (first.book_id != second.book_id || first.line != second.line) {
432:                 continue;
433:             }
434: 
435:             const size_t distance = first.word_idx > second.word_idx
436:                                         ? first.word_idx - second.word_idx
437:                                         : second.word_idx - first.word_idx;
438:             if (distance <= dis) {
439:                 matches.push_back(first);
440:                 matches.push_back(second);
441:             }
442:         }
443:     }
444: 
445:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
446: 
447:     return matches;
448: }

450: Context get_context_range(const std::vector<Book>& books, const Index& idx) {
451:     if (idx.book_id >= books.size()) {
452:         return {};
453:     }
454:     const Book& book = books[idx.book_id];
455: 
456:     if (idx.line >= book.lines.size() || is_blank_line(book.lines[idx.line])) {
457:         return {};
458:     }
459:     size_t cur_begin = idx.line;
460: 
461:     while (cur_begin > 0 && !is_blank_line(book.lines[cur_begin - 1])) {
462:         cur_begin--;
463:     }
464: 
465:     size_t cur_end = idx.line + 1;
466:     while (cur_end < book.lines.size() && !is_blank_line(book.lines[cur_end])) {
467:         cur_end++;
468:     }
469: 
470:     Context context{
471:         .cur = LineRange{.begin = cur_begin, .end = cur_end},
472:     };
473: 
474:     size_t prev_end = cur_begin;
475:     while (prev_end > 0 && is_blank_line(book.lines[prev_end - 1])) {
476:         --prev_end;
477:     }
478: 
479:     size_t prev_begin = prev_end;
480:     while (prev_begin > 0 && !is_blank_line(book.lines[prev_begin - 1])) {
481:         --prev_begin;
482:     }
483: 
484:     if (prev_begin < prev_end) {
485:         context.prev = LineRange{.begin = prev_begin, .end = prev_end};
486:     }
487: 
488:     size_t next_begin = cur_end;
489:     while (next_begin < book.lines.size() && is_blank_line(book.lines[next_begin])) {
490:         ++next_begin;
491:     }
492: 
493:     size_t next_end = next_begin;
494:     while (next_end < book.lines.size() && !is_blank_line(book.lines[next_end])) {
495:         ++next_end;
496:     }
497: 
498:     if (next_begin < next_end) {
499:         context.next = LineRange{.begin = next_begin, .end = next_end};
500:     }
501: 
502:     return context;
503: }
504: 
505: std::tuple<std::string, std::string, std::string> SearchEngine::get_context(
506:     const Index& idx) const {
507:     if (idx.book_id >= books.size()) {
508:         return {};
509:     }
510: 
511:     const Book& book = books[idx.book_id];
512:     const Context context = get_context_range(books, idx);
513: 
514:     return {
515:         lines_to_string(book.lines, context.prev),
516:         lines_to_string(book.lines, context.cur),
517:         lines_to_string(book.lines, context.next)
518:     };
519: }
